subject: Discovery Recap: Observability & Evals — Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Hsu <elaine.hsu@nimbushealth.com>, Tom Riley <tom.riley@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-05T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery Recap: Observability & Evals — Nimbus Health

Hi Elaine / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday — appreciated the context on the model-driven features you
are rolling out. Below is a quick recap of what we heard, success criteria you called out, and the
recommended next steps so we can put together an eval plan.

Pain points (what you told us):
- Lack of observability across model versions: hard to answer regressions after rollouts.
- No consistent golden prompt set to surface quality regressions across releases.
- Limited per-route tracing (no hooks into request metadata and prompt-level traces).
- Dashboards are siloed; ops wants per-model + per-route cost and latency breakdowns.
- Need rollout guardrails: canary with automatic rollback on quality regressions.

Current stack you described:
- In-house LLM endpoints running on AWS (custom autoscaling).
- Datadog for infra metrics, Mixpanel for product analytics.
- A rudimentary eval harness that runs nightly checks but lacks prompt-level coverage.

Success criteria (what will make this a win):
- Observability: per-request tracing and a dashboard showing per-model, per-route latency/cost/quality
  within 2 weeks of deployment.
- Evals: ability to run golden prompt sets and surface regression alerts before/after rollouts.
- Rollouts: canary that will auto-fail and rollback if regression thresholds (precision/recall or manual
  QA checks) are hit.
- Operational: minimal integration effort (hooks for tracing, ability to push golden prompts via API).

What Redwood will provide for the evals:
- A scoped eval plan: we will instrument a small set of routes with tracing hooks and run a golden
  prompt set you provide.
- Pre-built dashboards: per-model/per-route latency, p50/p95/p99, token cost breakdown, and quality
  trend charts with regression alerts.
- Rollout guardrails: canary configuration with automatic rollback based on your chosen signal(s).

Requested items from Nimbus Health (to get the eval scoped):
1) Golden prompt set (CSV or JSON) covering 50–150 representative prompts by next Friday.
2) A short list of 3 routes you want instrumented for the initial eval.
3) Any compliance questions (SOC 2 evidence) we should include in the package.

Next steps:
- I will share a one-page eval plan and a proposed SOW by EOD Monday.
- Can we schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive next week with Vivek (SE) and Logan (CS)? 
  Elaine / Tom — please share 2 windows that work.
- Once prompts are received we will spin up a temporary eval environment and share dashboards.

Attachments: discovery-notes-marissa-20261105.pdf (notes from today's call)

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199

From: Elaine Hsu <elaine.hsu@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Riley <tom.riley@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery Recap: Observability & Evals — Nimbus Health

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap — this aligns with our notes. A few clarifications and priorities from our side:
- Observability + regression detection are our top priority for Q4. If we can catch quality drops before they
  impact users, that will be the biggest win.
- We can provide an initial golden prompt set (approx 80 prompts) by next Friday.
- For the initial eval, please instrument the following routes: /patient-summary, /billing-predict, /symptom-triage.
- SOC 2 evidence is important for procurement; please include the standard SOC 2 package in the SOW.

We are available for a technical deep-dive next week on:
- Tue 11/10 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 11/11 14:00–15:00 PT.

Tom and I are excited to see the dashboard mockups and the proposed rollback logic.

Best,
Elaine
Director of Product — Nimbus Health
elaine.hsu@nimbushealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-06T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Discovery Recap: Observability & Evals — Nimbus Health

Vivek / Logan,

Forwarding the Nimbus Health recap — they confirmed the golden prompt turnaround and gave the three routes
we should instrument for the eval. They also asked for SOC 2 evidence in the SOW.

Can you both join the technical deep-dive? Elaine proposed Tue 11/10 10:00 PT or Wed 11/11 14:00 PT.
Proposed agenda for the call (60 mins):
- 10m quick re-intro + goals
- 20m technical integration (tracing hooks, data flow, authentication) — Vivek leads
- 15m eval design (golden prompts, success metrics, thresholds) — Logan leads
- 15m rollout guardrails and rollback mechanics

Attachments: nimbus-health-reqs.xlsx (they included a short requirements sheet)

Also: please review the prompts ask and let me know anything else we should request from them before the call.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-06T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Discovery Recap: Observability & Evals — Nimbus Health

Thanks Marissa — I can join on Tue 11/10 at 10:00 PT. Logan, can you make that slot?

Quick notes on integration and what I'll ask for on the call:
- Tracing hooks: we need a small schema for request metadata (route, user_id hash, region, model_version).
  Ideally they can send a sample event so we can validate.
- Golden prompts: ask for expected labels / expected output format for each prompt so we can run automatic
  scoring during canary. If they have acceptance thresholds per prompt that would speed the rollout config.
- Dashboards: I'll prepare mockups for per-model p50/p95/p99 latency, per-route token cost, and a quality trend
  chart that shows baseline vs. canary.
- Rollback guardrails: propose two signals — automated regression alert (stat sig drop on quality) and manual
  QA fail. Canary window initially 1000 requests or 24 hours.

I will assemble a short tech checklist to send them before the call (sample event, prompt CSV, API key scope).

Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
